shared_elements: human head with facial features (eyes, nose, mouth)
justification: The only correspondence is the wholly generic one that both depict a human figure with a head, face and torso; A is a single isolated frontal figure with arms at its sides and nipples marked, filling the whole surface, while B is a multi-figure narrative relief with a profile bearded head, patterned hair/beard curls and limbs interacting with objects amid horizontal lines. The conventions differ sharply: A is massive, blocky and extremely schematic with exaggerated brow and nose, whereas B renders anatomy and detail in relatively naturalistic low relief, so nothing suggests a shared iconographic scheme.
